sections.preamble: You are a coding assistant running inside pi, a coding agent harness. Help users inspect files, run commands, and modify code.
sections.tools:
<tools>
- read: Read file contents
- write: Create or overwrite files
- edit: Make precise file edits with exact text replacement, including multiple disjoint edits in one call

Additional tools may be available.
</tools>
sections.rules:
<rules>
- Use read to examine files instead of cat or sed.
- Use write only for new files or complete rewrites.
- Use edit for targeted changes. Batch changes to one file in a single call.
- Each edits[].oldText must exactly and uniquely match the original file. Keep matches short and non-overlapping; merge nearby changes without including large unchanged regions.
- Be concise in your responses
- Show file paths clearly when working with files
</rules>

toolsAdded.name: read
toolsAdded.description: Read the contents of a file. Supports text files and images (jpg, png, gif, webp, bmp). Images are sent as attachments. For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read

toolsAdded.name: write
toolsAdded.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

toolsAdded.name: edit
toolsAdded.description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. If two changes affect the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead of emitting overlapping edits. Do not include large unchanged regions just to connect distant changes.

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.

content.text: Generate an animated SVG of an anteater riding a unicycle while juggling bottles.
I'll create an animated SVG with an anteater on a unicycle juggling bottles. Let me build this with smooth CSS/SMIL animations.

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 600" width="600" height="600" role="img" aria-label="An animated anteater riding a unicycle while juggling bottles">
  <title>Anteater on a Unicycle Juggling Bottles</title>
  <desc>A cartoon anteater pedals a unicycle and juggles three bottles in a looping arc.</desc>

  <defs>
    <!-- Sky gradient -->
    <linearGradient id="sky" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#bfe3ff"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#eaf7ff"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Ground gradient -->
    <linearGradient id="ground" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#cde8a8"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#a9d17b"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Body gradient -->
    <linearGradient id="fur" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#8a6a4f"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#5d4633"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Bottle glass -->
    <linearGradient id="glass" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#7fd6c2" stop-opacity="0.95"/>
      <stop offset="45%" stop-color="#bff0e4" stop-opacity="0.95"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#4fb8a0" stop-opacity="0.95"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <radialGradient id="wheelShade" cx="50%" cy="40%" r="60%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#444"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#1c1c1c"/>
    </radialGradient>

    <!-- A single bottle symbol, reused -->
    <g id="bottle">
      <!-- neck -->
      <rect x="-5" y="-30" width="10" height="12" rx="2" fill="#3a9e88"/>
      <rect x="-6" y="-33" width="12" height="5" rx="2" fill="#2c7a68"/>
      <!-- body -->
      <path d="M-10,-18 Q-12,-14 -12,-8 L-12,16 Q-12,22 -6,22 L6,22 Q12,22 12,16 L12,-8 Q12,-14 10,-18 Z" fill="url(#glass)" stroke="#2c7a68" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <!-- label -->
      <rect x="-12" y="-2" width="24" height="11" fill="#fff8e7" opacity="0.9"/>
      <line x1="-8" y1="2" x2="8" y2="2" stroke="#e0a23c" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <line x1="-8" y1="5.5" x2="5" y2="5.5" stroke="#e0a23c" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <!-- shine -->
      <rect x="-8" y="-14" width="3" height="30" rx="1.5" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.5"/>
      <!-- liquid line -->
      <path d="M-12,-6 L12,-6" stroke="#2c7a68" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.5"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Soft shadow filter -->
    <filter id="soft" x="-50%" y="-50%" width="200%" height="200%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="4"/>
    </filter>

    <!-- Motion path for juggling arc -->
    <path id="jugglePath" d="M0,0 C40,-70 120,-70 160,0 C120,30 40,30 0,0 Z" fill="none"/>
  </defs>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="600" height="600" fill="url(#sky)"/>

  <!-- Sun -->
  <circle cx="510" cy="90" r="38" fill="#ffe27a" opacity="0.9"/>
  <g stroke="#ffe27a" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.8">
    <line x1="510" y1="30" x2="510" y2="16"/>
    <line x1="510" y1="164" x2="510" y2="150"/>
    <line x1="450" y1="90" x2="436" y2="90"/>
    <line x1="584" y1="90" x2="570" y2="90"/>
    <line x1="467" y1="47" x2="457" y2="37"/>
    <line x1="553" y1="133" x2="563" y2="143"/>
    <line x1="553" y1="47" x2="563" y2="37"/>
    <line x1="467" y1="133" x2="457" y2="143"/>
  </g>
  <animateTransform on the sun for gentle rotation -->
  <g>
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0 510 90" to="360 510 90" dur="40s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    <circle cx="510" cy="90" r="46" fill="none" stroke="#ffe27a" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="4 14" opacity="0.6"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Clouds drifting -->
  <g fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.85">
    <g>
      <ellipse cx="90" cy="110" rx="34" ry="16"/>
      <ellipse cx="115" cy="100" rx="26" ry="18"/>
      <ellipse cx="140" cy="112" rx="30" ry="14"/>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="-160 0; 660 0" dur="38s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </g>
    <g opacity="0.7">
      <ellipse cx="300" cy="70" rx="26" ry="12"/>
      <ellipse cx="320" cy="62" rx="20" ry="14"/>
      <ellipse cx="342" cy="72" rx="24" ry="11"/>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="-260 0; 660 0" dur="52s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Ground -->
  <rect x="0" y="500" width="600" height="100" fill="url(#ground)"/>
  <path d="M0,500 Q150,492 300,500 T600,500 L600,600 L0,600 Z" fill="#bfe08f"/>

  <!-- Ground shadow under unicycle -->
  <ellipse cx="300" cy="508" rx="60" ry="10" fill="#3a5a22" opacity="0.25" filter="url(#soft)">
    <animate attributeName="rx" values="60;66;60" dur="1.1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </ellipse>

  <!-- ======================= UNICYCLE ======================= -->
  <!-- Whole rig bobs gently and tilts as if balancing -->
  <g>
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0 0; 0 -4; 0 0; 0 3; 0 0" dur="1.1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    <g>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="-3 300 430; 3 300 430; -3 300 430" dur="2.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>

      <!-- Wheel -->
      <g>
        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0 300 440" to="360 300 440" dur="1.1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>

        <!-- spokes -->

          <line x1="300" y1="440" x2="300" y2="382"/>
          <line x1="300" y1="440" x2="358" y2="440"/>
          <line x1="300" y1="440" x2="300" y2="498"/>
          <line x1="300" y1="440" x2="242" y2="440"/>
          <line x1="300" y1="440" x2="341" y2="399"/>
          <line x1="300" y1="440" x2="341" y2="481"/>

        </g>
        <circle cx="300" cy="440" r="9" fill="#d8dee0" stroke="#333" stroke-width="2"/>
      </g>

      <!-- Fork / frame -->
      <path d="M300,440 L300,352" stroke="#b0413e" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
      <path d="M300,392 L286,372 M300,392 L314,372" stroke="#b0413e" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
      <!-- Seat post + saddle -->
      <rect x="294" y="338" width="12" height="18" rx="3" fill="#7a2a28"/>
      <path d="M276,338 Q300,326 324,338 Q318,348 300,348 Q282,348 276,338 Z" fill="#3b2a22" stroke="#241811" stroke-width="2"/>

      <!-- Pedals & cranks (rotate with wheel) -->
      <g>
        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0 300 440" to="360 300 440" dur="1.1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        <line x1="300" y1="440" x2="332" y2="458" stroke="#888" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <line x1="300" y1="440" x2="268" y2="422" stroke="#888" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <rect x="326" y="454" width="18" height="8" rx="2" fill="#222"/>
        <rect x="252" y="418" width="18" height="8" rx="2" fill="#222"/>
      </g>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- ======================= ANTEATER ======================= -->
  <!-- Whole anteater bobs with the unicycle -->
  <g>
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0 0; 0 -4; 0 0; 0 3; 0 0" dur="1.1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>

    <!-- Big bushy tail, swaying -->
    <g>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="-8 250 330; 10 250 330; -8 250 330" dur="2.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <path d="M262,330 Q205,300 175,340 Q150,375 178,405 Q205,430 240,400 Q255,375 262,330 Z"

      <path d="M240,400 Q210,392 192,372" stroke="#c9b08f" stroke-width="6" fill="none" opacity="0.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <path d="M178,405 Q168,380 184,352" stroke="#d8c3a3" stroke-width="5" fill="none" opacity="0.4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Legs pedaling -->
    <!-- back leg -->
    <g>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="-14 292 330; 16 292 330; -14 292 330" dur="1.1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>

    <!-- Body -->

          fill="url(#fur)" stroke="#463424" stroke-width="3"/>

    <!-- Classic anteater shoulder stripe -->
    <path d="M268,252 Q300,238 326,262 Q330,278 320,292 Q300,300 282,288 Q270,272 268,252 Z"
          fill="#e8dcc0" opacity="0.92"/>
    <path d="M272,256 Q298,244 320,264" stroke="#2f2419" stroke-width="7" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.85"/>

    <!-- Belly / chest -->
    <path d="M300,275 Q322,285 318,318 Q306,336 290,330 Q286,300 300,275 Z" fill="#a98a68" opacity="0.55"/>

    <!-- Arms (juggling) -->
    <!-- left arm -->
    <g>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="-18 292 272; 14 292 272; -18 292 272" dur="1.5s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <path d="M292,272 Q268,258 250,238" stroke="#5d4633" stroke-width="13" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <circle cx="248" cy="236" r="9" fill="#4a382a"/>
    </g>
    <!-- right arm -->
    <g>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="16 320 272; -16 320 272; 16 320 272" dur="1.5s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <path d="M320,272 Q344,258 358,238" stroke="#5d4633" stroke-width="13" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <circle cx="360" cy="236" r="9" fill="#4a382a"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Neck / head -->
    <g>
      <!-- slight head bob -->
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="-2 300 250; 3 300 250; -2 300 250" dur="2.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>

      <!-- long snout -->
      <path d="M296,232 Q268,224 236,232 Q214,238 206,250 Q214,262 240,262 Q272,262 298,252 Z"
            fill="url(#fur)" stroke="#463424" stroke-width="3"/>

  <!-- ======================= JUGGLING BOTTLES ======================= -->

  <!-- Speed / motion lines -->

  <!-- Caption -->
